title: Sentient Mythic Artifact
body: Legendary item sheet covering forging materials, active enchantments, awakened personality, curses, and historical owners.

fields.name: Form & Rare Materials
fields.hint: Star-iron blade, phoenix-ash glass, or carved leviathan ivory

sampleValues.Artifact Name: Whisperglass, Edge of the First Oath
sampleValues.Form & Rare Materials: Translucent smoky-quartz rapier hilted in blackened sea-gold
sampleValues.Passive & Awakened Powers: Rings audibly whenever a spoken lie is uttered within twenty paces; cuts cleanly through summoned ward barriers.
sampleValues.Personality & Demands (If Sentient): Speaks only in concise legal riddles; refuses to draw blood unless a formal challenge has been declared.
sampleValues.Drawback, Cost or Curse: Forces its wielder to keep every promise they speak aloud, even jesting vows.
sampleValues.Famous Former Bearers:
Lady Seraphina | Age of Crowns | Vanished into the Mirror Trench
Judge Haldor | 312 AC | Executed for refusing to lie under torture
